title: How John Rush launches 100+ products: traffic-first directories, Twitter validation, movie-style launches
summary: John Rush explains how he picks and ships projects fast: scratch his own itch for SaaS tools, reverse-engineer keyword traffic for directories, and validate with a single tweet. He prioritizes by launching unfinished and letting users "scream", and markets with a movie-style teaser and launch blast.

principles.text: Launch unfinished, far earlier than feels comfortable; early users tell you the few things to fix, so priorities sort themselves.
principles.quote: I just launch stuff very early uh earlier than normal people do like way before you're embarrassed even way before it work it works to be honest

principles.text: Work reactively on what is urgent; products with users 'scream' at you, so you never need to-do lists, and keep 20-30% time for spontaneous projects.
principles.quote: I only work on urgent things uh it means that I just look at all the things I can do and I see like what I have to do today that I if I do tomorrow it's too late right

principles.text: Build SaaS tools to fix your own problems; if something is great for you, many others will like it too.
principles.quote: it turns out that if something is great for me it's also great for a lot of the people not all but there's huge number of people who are also happy with things I'm happy with

principles.text: For directories, reverse-engineer from keywords: find high-traffic keywords with no product, then build a fast information site before the window closes.
principles.quote: I go for the traffic I find the Anta potential in the traffic there's a lot of it it's like there are like a lot of key keywords uh with high traffic and no product so the traffic goes to blogs and I just build that product

principles.text: Validate ideas with traffic data plus one tweet; if your audience doesn't react within about 30 minutes, shelve it.
principles.quote: the only thing I do to validate ideas is to see traffic and see a reaction on Twitter

principles.text: Market like a movie: tease and build anticipation, then spend most of the effort in a blast around launch.
principles.quote: they burn 80% of all marketing money just in two weeks with a blast right that's what I do as well so pretty much my marketing strategy is 100% the same as the movie with strategy
